name: cappu
description: Claude Code skills for using cappu, the Java package manager, build tool, language server, MCP server and debug adapter.

plugins.name: cappu
plugins.description: Skills for Java projects built with cappu: project setup and cappu.json, dependencies and audit, build/check/test/format, CI and releases, code navigation through the cappu MCP server, DAP debugging, and migration from Maven or Gradle. Also registers the read-only cappu MCP server.
